You thrilled us then, and you still thrill us now. Sharpy duly nailed his five consecutive runs in this event, while Spen has seven in a row.
Surely he can't be serious!] Was Spen deluded with his optimistic chirrup? Er, not really, when you consider we won the next year by 6-and-a-half minutes, and then in 2003 as well.
